comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Customer pilot on two enterprise tenants completed without password bypass. Done.

content.text: Customer pilot on two enterprise tenants completed without password bypass. Done.
Some regulated workspaces need every new member to authenticate via SSO from the first login. Today invites can still choose password signup if the admin only enabled SSO without enforcing it.

Add a workspace auth setting force_sso_for_invites. When true, invitation emails send users through the IdP only; password and magic-link signup routes reject invite tokens for that workspace with a clear error. Existing password members are unaffected until a separate migration policy is chosen.
Shipped criteria: default off, only owners can toggle, Directory-provisioned users already SSO-bound keep working, and audit log records enforcement changes.
